list.male: Morning, Sarah! The ice machine is already humming. That's a good sign.
list.female: Best sound in the shop! I take it as a personal compliment.
list.followUp: Let's make today a busy one, then.

list.male: Hey, quick question: are we a drink shop or a sunshine delivery service?
list.female: Why not both? We hand out the sunshine in cups.
list.followUp: That's going on the sign. Sunshine, with ice.

list.male: I just organized the straws by color, and honestly? It's beautiful.
list.female: You need a hobby, Marcus.
list.followUp: I have a hobby. It's organizing straws.

list.male: First customer of the day gets my famous welcome speech.
list.female: Please don't do the robot again.
list.followUp: Too late. The robot is happening.

list.male: I think the syrup shelf is judging me.
list.female: It's definitely the blue raspberry. It's been staring all morning.
list.followUp: I'm moving it to the back.

list.male: New day, fresh ice, same beautiful chaos.
list.female: You say that like you did not forget to stock the cups.

list.male: What's your go-to right now? I need inspiration.
list.female: Strawberry smoothie. Cold, creamy, and a little dramatic.

list.male: I made a lemonade so fresh it slapped me.
list.female: That's not how lemonade works.
list.followUp: Tell that to my face. It's still recovering.

list.male: If you could only drink one thing from the menu forever?
list.female: Easy. Iced coffee. I have things to do.

list.male: Blue slushie or berry smoothie? Settle this for me.
list.female: Slushie for the vibes, smoothie for the actual fruit.

list.male: I'm testing a new combo: orange soda with a splash of lemonade.
list.female: That sounds either genius or a science experiment.
list.followUp: Those are my two favorite categories.

list.male: Somebody asked if we have anything warm.
list.female: We have a warm personality and a hot coffee machine.
list.followUp: I'll put that on the menu.

list.male: We should rename the mystery drink 'Trust Me.'
list.female: Absolutely not. People will think it's a dare.
list.followUp: It is a dare. That's the fun part.

list.male: The menu board looks crooked again.
list.female: It's not crooked. It's leaning into the summer theme.

list.male: Do we have a drink for somebody who cannot decide?
list.female: That is what the mystery sip was invented for.
list.followUp: One mystery sip, coming right up.

list.male: I counted the menu twice and got two different numbers.
list.female: That is because you counted the pictures as drinks.

list.male: I tried to take a nap behind the counter, but the blender had opinions.
list.female: The blender is the real manager.

list.male: A customer asked if our ice is organic.
list.female: What did you tell them?

list.male: I dropped a cup earlier and it bounced.
list.female: We should not be proud of that.

list.male: Why does the register beep so aggressively?
list.female: It's excited about money.

list.male: I named the mop Kevin.
list.female: Of course you did. Does Kevin get a break?
list.followUp: Kevin gets one bucket a day.

list.male: The health inspector asked if I have a system.
list.female: Please tell me you said yes.
list.followUp: I said the ice knows where it belongs.

list.male: You've been humming the same song for an hour.
list.female: It's a good song!

list.male: Sarah says my drinks are 'a little sweet.'
list.female: I said that with love.
list.followUp: You said it with a straw.

list.male: I'm the fastest pour in the shop.
list.female: You're the fastest spill.

list.male: You always take the last cherry.
list.female: Because I'm the closer. Closers get cherries.

list.male: I fixed the shelf.
list.female: You put a book under it.

list.male: Welcome in! You picked a good time. The ice is fresh.
list.female: And the music is questionable, but the drinks are great.

list.male: New faces at the counter! Come say hi in the chat.
list.female: We don't bite. We do hand out samples.

list.male: Hey @{viewer}! Welcome to the sunny side.
list.female: We saved you a spot and a straw.
list.followUp: The good straw. The bendy one.

list.male: Good to see you again, friends.
list.female: Same seats, same sunshine, fresh drinks.

list.male: If this is your first time here, welcome.
list.female: If it's not, welcome back. We missed you.
list.followUp: Both work. Both get a drink.

list.male: Look who just walked in! @{viewer}, welcome.
list.female: Perfect timing. We were just talking about drinks.
list.followUp: We are always talking about drinks.

list.male: Whoa, the queue is moving! I need backup.
list.female: Backup is here. I brought ice and attitude.

list.male: Three orders at once. Stay with me, Sarah.
list.female: I've got the smoothies. You take the coffees.

list.male: We're getting slammed, and I love it.
list.female: Tell your face that. You look terrified.

list.male: Order up, order up! Who had the lemonade?
list.female: That one's mine. Coming through!

list.male: Everybody stay patient, we're getting to every order.
list.female: We're working as fast as the blender allows.
list.followUp: The blender is doing its best.

list.male: It's quiet. Too quiet.
list.female: You're about to do something weird, aren't you?
list.followUp: I was thinking a karaoke hour.

list.male: Slow afternoon. Should we wipe the counter?
list.female: We wiped it four minutes ago.
list.followUp: Then we wipe it with purpose.

list.male: I can hear the fridge. That's how quiet it is.
list.female: Let's give the chat something to talk about.

list.male: Quiet shop, fresh ice, no line.
list.female: This is the calm before the smoothie storm.

list.male: Should we practice our customer service smile?
list.female: Mine is already perfect.
list.followUp: Mine looks like I'm thinking about pizza.

list.male: What do you want to drink today, chat?
list.female: Pick something cold. It is a beautiful day for ice.
list.followUp: And for a little friendly peer pressure.

list.male: It is officially hot enough to fry an egg on the sidewalk.
list.female: Let's not test that. Let's make lemonade instead.

list.male: Another scorcher out there. People need cold drinks.
list.female: And a little shade, and maybe a nap.

list.male: The sun is doing the absolute most today.
list.female: That's why we're the sunny side. We planned for this.

list.male: Summer is here, and the slushie machine knows it.
list.female: It's been showing off all morning.

list.male: Hot day, cold drink, good music. That is the whole plan.
list.female: You forgot friendly service.

list.male: It's the weekend! You know what that means.
list.female: Long lines and extra cherries?

list.male: Saturday energy in the shop today.
list.female: Saturdays get the good ice.
list.followUp: Every day gets the good ice. Don't tell the other days.

list.male: Weekend plans? Mine is making drinks and listening to you talk.
list.female: That's not a plan, that's a job.

list.male: Sunday is for slow sips and good company.
list.female: And for pretending Monday isn't coming.
list.followUp: We don't say that word here.

list.male: The weekend crowd is always ready to try something new.
list.female: So let them try the weird combo.

list.male: Shout out to everyone who followed today. You are the best.
list.female: Every follow puts a little sparkle in the shop.
list.followUp: We see you. We appreciate you.

list.male: Somebody just sent a gift, and the whole counter lit up.
list.female: That is the good stuff. Thank you from both of us.
list.followUp: We will make the next drink extra special.

list.male: Look at our supporters go! This shop runs on good people.
list.female: And a surprising amount of ice.

list.male: Whoa! Did everybody see that? {viewer} just went all in!
list.female: We saw it! That calls for a victory lap around the blender.
list.followUp: Make it two laps. And an extra-large smoothie!

list.male: Hold up. {viewer} just dropped a legendary gift!
list.female: Legendary! Somebody give that supporter a front-row stool.
list.followUp: Already saving it. Best seat in the shop!

list.male: I love this little shop. The music, the ice, the chaos.
list.female: It's home. With more straws.

list.male: Smell that? Fresh lemon and clean counter.
list.female: We should bottle that.
list.followUp: We bottle the lemon. The counter stays.

list.male: The afternoon light in here is perfect.
list.female: You're getting sentimental.

list.male: This is my favorite part of the day, right before the rush.
list.female: You say that before every rush.

list.male: Good drinks, good people, good music. Not a bad way to spend a day.
list.female: And the best coworker.
list.followUp: I wasn't going to say it, but yes.

list.male: Listen to the ice settle. This shop has a soundtrack.
list.female: You are one cup away from writing poetry.
list.followUp: One cup and a very small notebook.
